overview: Boulder Ridge Villas are Disney Vacation Club rooms inside the Wilderness Lodge, styled after the railroad era of the American West. They share all of the Lodge's restaurants and its boat to Magic Kingdom.
suits: Families who love the Wilderness Lodge and want a kitchen and more space.
rooms: As a Disney Vacation Club resort, rooms range from studios with a kitchenette to multi-bedroom villas with a full kitchen and washer and dryer. You don't need to be a member to stay; you can book with cash like a regular hotel.
pools: Boulder Ridge Cove Pool is a quieter pool for this wing, and guests can use the Wilderness Lodge's main pool too.
dining: Guests use the Wilderness Lodge restaurants, including Whispering Canyon Cafe and Geyser Point Bar & Grill.
cons: Buses to every park except Magic Kingdom
A walk from the main lobby
Rooms are older than Copper Creek's
tips: Use the quieter Boulder Ridge pool for a calmer swim.
Groceries can be delivered to make the most of the kitchen.
bestFor: Families who want villa space at the Wilderness Lodge.
